hypothesis.statement: The pilot-selected predictive/persistent learner with safety weight1.5 independently acquires balanced food, thermal regulation and avoidance on fresh training seeds and held-out worlds.
hypothesis.direction: independent full confirmation of a fixed learned agent configuration
hypothesis.rationale: Pilot safety1.5 passed all six unchanged criteria on3/3 training seeds and14/15 evaluation worlds, while safety1 failed proximity. Select1.5 by the earlier preregistered preference even though2 also passed. Confirm the whole configuration on disjoint data; do not pool pilot outcomes or adjust settings after seeing these results.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject satisfactory confirmation unless all5 selected-candidate training-seed averages pass every fixed criterion, at least20 of25 final evaluation worlds jointly pass all6, all25 worlds pass hunger.mean<=.35 and hunger.above<=.1, and each of5 training seeds improves hunger by>=.1 and thermal MAE by>=.5 versus its untrained/initial frozen policy. Technical completion alone is insufficient. Any failure is retained and triggers a new hypothesis/new seed pool; no seed/checkpoint replacement or threshold relaxation.

sources.title: Live safety-weight-pilot-01 preregistered selection
sources.mechanism: Independently validate a fixed combination of self-supervised interoceptive features, scalar control learning, temporally persistent exploration and relative safety cost.
sources.limitations: The confirmation establishes this configuration on ecology-v2's seed distribution, not universal algorithm superiority or transfer to altered physics. Proximity/contact are proxies, not actual harm or survival. The agent has explicit motor/sensor geometry and relational feature priors; no teacher trajectories or expert actions. Persistence's exact causal effect is not isolated from its small change in realized exploration occupancy.

protocol.control: safety-w1--model-persistent, identical learner and fresh paired seeds. Random/untrained/initial frozen measured per trial.
protocol.fixedLearner: Relational Sarsa fixed normalization,lambda0 alpha.03 gamma.97,epsilon1->.05 in50k;2000 shared model-only warmup, RLS thermal predictor then frozen;998000 TD updates; capped zeta2 exploration max32 after warmup with nominal occupancy correction. Greedy inference has no exploratory repeats or parameter updates.
protocol.fixedMotivation: Reweighted-homeostasis exponent1, safety multiplier1.5, all other multipliers1, existing weighted-mean reward mapping. Control multiplier1. Physical drives and criteria untouched.
protocol.checkpointRule: Assess final1M only. Curves at0/250k/500k/750k/1M are descriptive, never used for checkpoint selection. Keep every training seed and result.
protocol.unitOfReplication: Training seed N=5 after within-seed averaging5 evaluation worlds.25 world episodes are a secondary robustness check, not25 independent training replicates.
protocol.inferenceArtifactRule: If confirmed, use first prespecified training seed1009 final checkpoint as the demonstration artifact, not the empirically best seed. Verify export/load and frozen primitive action selection for every final candidate checkpoint.
protocol.decision: Apply falsification gate without tuning. Report every world failure, worst-world metrics, controls and training curves. A candidate passing this rule is satisfactory for the current baseline; broader conditions and sample efficiency remain further research.

decisionRule: Final1M only. Candidate all5 training averages pass all6 unchanged criteria;>=20/25 final worlds jointly pass all6;all25 pass both hunger criteria;each5 training seeds improves hunger>=.1 and MAE>=.5 over own untrained/initial. No tuning, seed/checkpoint replacement or pooling pilot data. Export first prespecified seed1009 if confirmed; verify all candidate exports.
